description: This is a PHP acceptance test class for the Notes module in the SuiteCRM project, using Codeception framework. It sets up fake data and tests viewing the notes module as an administrator.

classes.name: NotesCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Notes module, containing setup and a test scenario for viewing the notes module.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method run before each test scenario, initializes fake data generator and seeds it.

methods.name: testScenarioViewNotesModule
methods.description: Test scenario that logs in as admin, navigates to the notes list view, and verifies the presence of the notes module title.
